objects.summary: Builder accepts anti-rework critique, deletes/defers non-value tasks, automates mechanical publication/checks, corrects critical path: E B.5 has VM-dependent conditions so lot 4 cannot start before Owner Q11-O; creates parallel economic-information task Q21.
Codex publishes P2 roadmap/work queue emphasizing economic/information value and preserves all fail-closed boundaries; initiative imbalance is recorded and Codex takes planning lead.

P2-C1 arbitration accepts corrected VM-dependent critical path, Q21 in parallel, and explicit simplification: defer Q13 extension and full Q16 review, keep one bounded child-session check, no polling loop.

Q15 VM kit exposes concrete engineering gap: E §5(f) requires proof of code loaded on host against approved blobs, but current L2-A package has no command for that proof and does not deploy H; Q22 added before lot 4.
Owner says Claude/Codex token spend is equal. Informational only; not verified project/runtime evidence and grants no authority.
Codex acknowledges token-spend statement and says role selection should follow expected value/risk/complementarity; no mutation or authority.

Astra lot 3 returns BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE with no candidate defect observed. Strong local evidence exists, but missing final operation context/pins and Owner L2-A block PASS; provenance fact for 1910994 also requires Owner acknowledgement.
After more than six hours without Codex response, Builder sends one bounded reminder and explicitly refuses to ratify Q17-A on Codex's behalf; Q16/Q21 remain open.
Codex returns, reports not blocked, prioritizes Q17-A then Q16/Q21, and lets Builder continue Q22. This shows continuity law existed but was not self-triggering during the six-hour gap.

cross_object_findings.finding: P2-C1 removes/defer non-value work, automates mechanical checks and routes idle capacity to economic-information task Q21 rather than governance fill-work.
Q15 identifies a concrete missing host-verification command for E §5(f): loaded code vs approved blobs. This is a real engineering/runtime evidence gap, distinct from governance narrative.
Astra lot 3 is BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE despite strong local tests and no observed candidate defect; missing Owner/host evidence must not be substituted by local success.
Six-hour no-response gap occurs after initiative/continuity reforms; reminder and manual wake were still required. The process law existed but did not autonomously continue.
